articles.summary: Every map, every dispatch, every delivery starts with the same piece of data – where you are. For nearly half a century, GPS has helped the world find its place. But GPS performs best when one critical condition is met: a clear line of sight to satellites thousands of miles overhead. The moment that line is broken, the location it gives becomes less accurate.
articles.title: In Side-by-Side Demonstration, NextNav 5G PNT Network Delivers even when GPS Signals Can’t Break Through
